name: Ink Reveal Gallery
description: Editorial image gallery on a 12-column grid where hovering an image reveals an animated ink-marbling mask that switches the picture to a color effect, rendered with a WebGL shader.
contents: Grid of image tiles placed by column and row, each with date, title and subtitle
Fixed overlay of vertical grid guide lines
behavior: Hovering an image opens a turbulent ink-shaped mask that follows the cursor
Inside or outside the mask the image shows grayscale, sepia, duotone, pixelate or blur depending on effectType
Grid guide lines animate in on load with a stagger
Only images in view are rendered
On screens below 768px tiles stack in a single column
editableByProps: Images, dates, titles, subtitles, grid placement and heights of every tile
Colors, grid columns, gutter, spacing and padding
Mask size, speed, turbulence and durations
Effect type 0 to 5 (0 inverted gray, 1 gray, 2 sepia, 3 duotone, 4 pixelate, 5 blur) and its colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the ink mask shape or noise pattern

needsCodeEdit.where: u_effectType branches in main of FRAGMENT_SHADER

fixed: Grid guide overlay is position fixed over the whole viewport
Listens to document mousemove, so the reveal is hover only and has no touch equivalent
One WebGL renderer per image tile
Images load as WebGL textures and must allow cross-origin access
Tiles stack in one column below 768px
